description: Fetch the historical values of one chart as JSON rows {t, …fields} (units per field: describe_chart → fields). Use for trends, history and comparisons; use get_latest when only the current value matters. Time series are downsampled to maxPoints (default 500, max 2000; first/last points preserved). Use from/to (YYYY-MM-DD or an exact UTC timestamp) to window and granularity (5m|day|3day|week|month|year) where available. Five-minute data is retained for 30 days; daily data is closed-only unless includePartial=true explicitly requests the still-open UTC day. That row is partial:true with partialMethod (trailing24h: rolling 24h ending at asOf, comparable with closed days; asOf: a level as of asOf), estimated (true = blended from yesterday, not exact 5m data) and coverage (share of the UTC day elapsed); never sum it with closed days.

exchange.description: Venue scope for exchange-netflow only; default all.

from.description: Inclusive start, YYYY-MM-DD or UTC timestamp (…Z). Omit for full history.

granularity.description: Bucket size; must be one of the chart's availableGranularities (describe_chart).

includePartial.description: granularity=day only: append the still-open UTC day as a partial:true row.

maxPoints.description: Max rows returned after even downsampling (default 500).

to.description: Inclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD or UTC timestamp (…Z). Omit for "up to now".

name: get_chart
title: Get chart data
